name: chio
description: Native Chio session status, exact review, evidence and revocation requests for Claude Code. Execution authority remains in the kernel.

compatibility_hooks.title: Compatibility hooks
compatibility_hooks.description: bonded: check only sessions bonded with /chio:bond. always: deny tools in unbonded sessions. off: no compatibility checks. These hooks are a precheck, not an execution boundary.

control_url.title: Scoped Chio control origin
control_url.description: Exact http://127.0.0.1:PORT origin issued by the trusted operator for this session.

control_token.title: Session control credential
control_token.description: Session-scoped viewer and intent credential. Never enter an operator or kernel administrator credential.

policy_path.title: Policy path
policy_path.description: Path to the active Chio policy (.policy.yaml). Used by /chio:bond and the PreToolUse hook.

chio_binary.title: chio binary
chio_binary.description: Path to the `chio` CLI binary (default: chio on PATH).

service_token.title: Trust plane service token
service_token.description: Bearer token for the trust-control plane (only required when using a running `chio trust serve`).
